# Dango

> Discord AI Agent built on [Agno](https://docs.agno.com). Connects to any AI model provider — Google Gemini/Gemma, OpenAI, Anthropic, Groq, Ollama, and more. Features dual-model routing, multilingual complexity scoring, table-to-image rendering, and a browser-based setup dashboard. Drop it into a Discord channel and configure everything via slash commands — no restarts needed.

## Getting Started

- [Discord Setup](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zhiro-labs/dango/main/docs/getting-started/discord-setup.md): Create a Discord bot, enable required intents, and generate an invite link.
- [Docker Setup](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zhiro-labs/dango/main/docs/getting-started/docker.md): Recommended path — no Python required, configure from the browser.
- [uv Setup](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zhiro-labs/dango/main/docs/getting-started/uv.md): Developer path — clone, sync, fill `.env`, run.

## Configuration

- [Environment Variables](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zhiro-labs/dango/main/docs/configuration/env-vars.md): All env vars — model selection, routing, tools, Gemini-specific settings, per-model overrides.
- [Runtime Config](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zhiro-labs/dango/main/docs/configuration/runtime.md): `runtime.yml` and all Discord slash commands for live configuration.

## Features

- [Model Providers & Routing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zhiro-labs/dango/main/docs/features/models.md): `provider:model_id` format, supported providers, dual-model AUTO_ROUTE, error fallback, local models, context token budget.
- [Tools](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zhiro-labs/dango/main/docs/features/tools.md): DuckDuckGo search, website fetching, workspace file access, custom HTTP APIs, SQL databases.
- [Custom Commands & Tools](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zhiro-labs/dango/main/docs/features/extensions.md): Write your own Discord slash commands and agent tools in Python in a gitignored custom/ directory. Three decorators — @command, @agent_tool, @command_and_tool — with per-function opt-in for agent access. One function can be both a slash command and an LLM-callable tool; a normalized Ctx works across both call paths.
- [Workflow Architecture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zhiro-labs/dango/main/docs/features/workflow.md): Four-step Agno Workflow — FetchHistory → LLMChat → ExtractRenderTables → SendResponse. Entry points: `on_message` (chat) and `on_interaction` (button clicks, modal submits, context menus — routed via `dango_component:` / `dango_modal:` custom_id prefixes).

## Usage

- [Slash Commands](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zhiro-labs/dango/main/docs/usage/commands.md): Full reference for `/newchat`, `/deep`, `/addchannel`, `/sethistorylimit`, `/settimezone`, and all admin commands.
- [Conversations](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zhiro-labs/dango/main/docs/usage/conversations.md): How to start conversations, use images, reply context, `/newchat`, auto-routing, and other automatic behaviours.

## Advanced

- [Embedding into Another Bot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zhiro-labs/dango/main/docs/advanced/embedding.md): Load Dango's ChatCog and AdminCog into an existing discord.py bot to add natural-language chat, web search, read-URL, and workspace access on top of the host bot's own commands — all opt-in via env vars, no code changes beyond loading the Cogs. Includes a full Neko reminder bot integration example. To add your own commands/agent tools, see Custom Commands & Tools.
- [VPS Deployment](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zhiro-labs/dango/main/docs/advanced/vps.md): Secure the dashboard with SSH tunneling; configure Docker auto-restart.
